svg.title: LANL cyber1 - red team data flows
svg.desc: Pattern of the red team (fraudulent) activity in redteam.txt: reused credentials fanning out from beachhead computers, one account's burst, events per day, and how a red team line maps to auth.txt.
svg.text: B · ONE STOLEN ACCOUNT IN ACTION: U748@DOM1, DAY 2
Day 3: same account from a 2nd host C18025 → C1493 (3× in 4 min),
then again from C17693 → C148 (6× in 18 min) and C504 … continuing on day 6.
Peak for C17693: 46 distinct targets within one hour.
C · RED TEAM EVENTS PER DAY (58 DAYS)
up to 46 new targets per hour
redteam.txt; same events sit in auth.txt
E · EVERY RED TEAM LINE POINTS AT ONE AUTH EVENT
